description: NaMg₁₄BO₁₆ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pmmm space group. Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent MgO₆ octahedra, and edges with twelve MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.16-2.73 Å. There are eight inequivalent Mg sites. In the first Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with four MgO₆ octahedra, and edges with twelve MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.07-2.16 Å. In the second Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. There are four shorter (2.07 Å) and two longer (2.16 Å) Mg-O bond lengths. In the third Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with six MgO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, and edges with eight MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-31°. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.00-2.24 Å. In the fourth Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-2°. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.06-2.22 Å. In the fifth Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with six MgO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, and edges with ten MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-6°. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.07-2.21 Å. In the sixth Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-7°. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.07-2.20 Å. In the seventh Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with six MgO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, and edges with ten MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-6°. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.07-2.21 Å. In the eighth Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent MgO₆ octahedra,  an edgeedge with one NaO₆ octahedra, and edges with ten MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-31°. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.04-2.34 Å. B is bonded in a linear geometry to four O atoms. There are two shorter (1.41 Å) and two longer (2.16 Å) B-O bond lengths. There are nine inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to one Na and five Mg atoms to form ONaMg₅ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent ONaMg₅ octahedra, corners with two equivalent OMg₅ square pyramids, and edges with ten OMg₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-6°. In the second O site, O is bonded to five Mg atoms to form OMg₅ square pyramids that share corners with four ONaMg₅ octahedra, corners with three equivalent OMg₅ square pyramids, and edges with eight OMg₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 1-87°. In the third O site, O is bonded to six Mg atoms to form OMg₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent OMg₆ octahedra, edges with eight ONaMg₅ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent OMg₅ square pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-6°. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na and four Mg atoms to form ONa₂Mg₄ octahedra that share corners with six ONa₂Mg₄ octahedra and edges with eight ONaMg₅ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to four Mg and two equivalent B atoms to form OMg₄B₂ octahedra that share corners with six ONa₂Mg₄ octahedra, corners with four equivalent OMg₅ square pyramids, and edges with four equivalent OMg₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. In the sixth O site, O is bonded to six Mg atoms to form OMg₆ octahedra that share corners with six ONa₂Mg₄ octahedra and edges with twelve ONaMg₅ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. In the seventh O site, O is bonded to six Mg atoms to form OMg₆ octahedra that share corners with six OMg₄B₂ octahedra, edges with eight OMg₆ octahedra, and edges with four equivalent OMg₅ square pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Na, four Mg, and one B atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded to six Mg atoms to form OMg₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent OMg₆ octahedra, edges with ten ONaMg₅ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent OMg₅ square pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted.
